title: The Canine Resource Pack
description: The Canine Resource pack is all about the canines of real-life. Thanks to 1.21.0 there are now eight wolves, and we have changed them into the canines of Earth, outside the game.
body:
The Canine Resource Pack changes the classic Minecraft wolves into iconic real-life canines like the dingo, grey wolf and more. Thanks to 1.21.0 there are now eight wolves, and we have changed them into the canines of Earth, outside the game. With tame, angry, and average variations, this is the perfect resource pack for all those canine-lovers out there.

Dingo replaces Spotted,

Grey Wolf replaces Pale,

Maned Wolf replaces Rusty,

New Guinea Singing Dog replaces Black.
